android.desc:
Math Rush is a fun and engaging educational game that helps improve your arithmetic skills through exciting one-minute challenges.

Test your speed and accuracy by solving math problems before the timer runs out. Whether you're a student looking to sharpen your skills or someone who enjoys mental math, Math Rush offers a quick and enjoyable way to practice every day.

Features
⏱️ One-minute math challenges
➕ Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
🎯 Improve calculation speed and accuracy
📱 Simple and easy-to-use interface
🌐 Works completely offline
👨‍🎓 Suitable for students and math enthusiasts of all ages

Challenge yourself, beat your best score, and make learning math fun with Math Rush!
